fields.label: Plan Item ID
fields.description: Stable public reference (PPI-{PE code}-{FY start}-{3 digits}) preserved across successor copies; unique within a Plan Version (DB composite unique).

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Procurement package title; 5–160 characters.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Procurement-facing description; 10–1,000 characters.

fields.label: Strategic Objective
fields.description: Exactly one Active Strategic Objective valid for the PE and Plan period. Required before Finance request.

fields.label: Strategy Plan
fields.description: Objective lineage stored on selection (§7.2).

fields.label: Objective Path
fields.description: Display hierarchy path captured at selection.

fields.label: Requirement Type
fields.description: Derived from the accepted DPP classification. All combined sources share it.

fields.label: Procurement Method
fields.description: System-assigned Active MVP method (Open Tender). Read-only while it is the sole admitted method.

fields.label: Aggregation Reason
fields.description: Required only when more than one DPP entry forms the item; 20–500 characters.

fields.label: Procurement Category
fields.description: Goods, works or services — derived from the accepted DPP classification; the Second Schedule threshold matrix is keyed on it (§4.9).

fields.label: Multi-year Justification
fields.description: Required when the horizon is Multi-year; 20–500 characters (regulation 41(c), 40(2)).

fields.label: Aggregation
fields.options:
Not aggregated
Aggregated into this package
Common-user item arrangement

fields.label: Lot Count
fields.description: Required only when packaged into lots; lot specifications belong to Tender Management.

fields.label: Preference and Reservation Category
fields.description: Governed value from the effective-dated regulator reference for the plan's Fiscal Year; required before plan funding confirmation, None is an explicit choice (§4.9).

fields.label: Reservation Category Reason
fields.description: Required only when a lower-advantage scheme than the server's highest-advantage proposal is recorded (section 156, regulation 153).

fields.label: County Resident-Tenderer Reservation
fields.description: Available only where the site entity is a county entity (regulation 40(5)).

fields.label: Exclusive Preference (derived)
fields.description: Regulation 163 — derived from funding source and planned value, never entered.

fields.label: Threshold Band at Readiness
fields.description: The value band resolved when readiness last passed, retained so a historical plan stays auditable after a gazette change.

fields.label: Target Invitation Date
fields.description: The one Planner-set anchor; locked once the Plan Version leaves Draft (§4.9).

fields.label: Tendering Period (days)
fields.description: Governed floor 7 (regulation 86).

fields.label: Evaluation Period (days)
fields.description: Governed ceiling 30 (Third Schedule).

fields.label: Award Approval Buffer (days)
fields.description: Planning assumption, not a statutory figure; defaults from the category/method register or 5.

fields.label: Notification Buffer (days)
fields.description: Planning assumption, not a statutory figure; defaults from the category/method register or 2.

fields.label: Standstill Period (days)
fields.description: Governed floor 14 (section 135(3)).

fields.label: Forecast — Invitation or Advertisement
fields.description: Null until activation; seeded from baseline on activation; changed only through the cascade preview/confirm commands.

fields.label: Forecast — Bid Opening

fields.label: Forecast — Delivery or Implementation Completion

fields.label: Actual — Invitation or Advertisement

fields.label: Item Status
fields.options:
Not started
In progress
Completed
Cancelled
fields.description: Third Schedule column 17 — derived from actuals where present.

fields.label: Item State
fields.options:
Draft
Dissolved
Active
Removed in successor
Superseded
fields.description: A Dissolved item is historical, read-only and excluded from Plan totals.

fields.label: Record Version
fields.description: Monotonic optimistic-concurrency token checked by every mutating command.
